en.headline: Hikers filmed trying to ride a resting cow at Ma On Shan
en.dek: A video circulating on Sunday showed a woman attempting to straddle cattle at Ngong Ping before a passer-by shouted at her to stop.
body: A video shared on social media on Sunday showed a hiker at Ngong Ping in Ma On Shan repeatedly approaching a brown cow lying on the grass and trying to swing a leg over its back while a companion filmed.

Hong Kong 01 reported that the clip shows a woman in a yellow cap patting the animal and attempting to straddle it. The cow turned its head; a person filming nearby shouted in Cantonese for her to stop, after which the pair walked away. The cow did not charge.

Ngong Ping on Ma On Shan is a popular hiking area where feral cattle are often seen. Animal groups quoted in local reports said the behaviour risked startling the animal and urged people not to touch or mount cattle. Hong Kong 01 said it had asked the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department for comment.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山昂平行山客試圖騎牛打卡 遭途人喝止
zh.dek: 周日流傳片段顯示女子在昂平多次嘗試跨上伏地黃牛，旁人喝止後兩人離開。
body: 周日社交平台流傳片段，顯示馬鞍山昂平一帶有行山女子多次走近一頭伏在草地上的啤色牛隻，並嘗試把腿跨上牛背，同行男子在旁拍攝。
《香港01》報道，片段中戴黃帽女子拍打牛背並試圖跨上，牛隻扭頭，附近拍片者用粵語喝止，兩人其後離開，牛隻沒有衝前。
馬鞍山昂平是熱門行山地點，附近常見散養牛隻。本地報道引述動物團體指有關行為可能驚嚇動物，呼籲市民不要觸摸或騎上牛隻。《香港01》表示已向漁農自然護理署查詢。
